Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Severe Tropical Storm OPONG
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 26 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Mauban, Sampaloc, Lucban, Tayabas, Lucena, Pagbilao, Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Agdangan, Gumaca, Unisan, Plaridel, Macalelon, Pitogo, General Luna, Catanauan, Mulanay, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Buenavista, Guinayangan, Lopez, Calauag, Tagkawayan, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Polillo, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Burdeos).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Zambales, Bataan, Tarlac, Pampanga, Nueva Ecija and Bulacan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Cavite, Metro Manila, Rizal, Batangas, Laguna and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Infanta, Real) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
